vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component implements an Angular CanActivateFn guard responsible for enforcing route-level authentication. It injects AuthService to check the user's login status via isLoggedIn(). If the user is authenticated, navigation proceeds; otherwise, it programmatically redirects the user to the '/login' route using the Router service. It acts as a critical gatekeeper for protected application routes.
